articles.title: Neuromorphic Computing Explained: How Brain-Inspired Hardware Computes with Spikes
articles.author: Vijayaramanan
articles.excerpt: Neuromorphic computers replace clocked, data-hungry processing with sparse spikes, local memory, and event-driven dynamics. This guide explains the models, chips, trade-offs, and engineering opportunities behind the architecture.

articles.title: Autonomous AI Agents: The System Architecture Beyond the LLM
articles.author: Vijayaramanan
articles.excerpt: An autonomous AI agent is not a larger prompt wrapped around an LLM. It is a closed-loop system combining state, planning, memory, tools, permissions, evaluation, and human oversight. This guide explains how those layers fit together—and where production systems fail.

articles.title: The Post-Titanium Era: How Super Steel Could Scale Green Hydrogen Production
articles.author: Vijayaramanan
articles.excerpt: A new generation of corrosion-resistant “super steel” could replace selected titanium components in PEM electrolyzers, cutting material costs while surviving high-voltage, chloride-rich conditions.

articles.title: Metric Engineering & Dynamic Spacetime Geometries: Beyond Alcubierre
articles.author: Vijayaramanan
articles.excerpt: Analyzing physical energy condition modifications, Lentz positive-energy soliton solutions, and pulsed electromagnetic field generation for sub-light and superluminal metric bubbles.

articles.title: Fundamentals of Gravitational Field Modification & Metric Engineering
articles.author: Vijayaramanan
